entities.summary: Johann Heinrich Eduard Nicolaus Graf von Keyserling was a Baltic German fiction writer and dramatist, an exponent of literary impressionism and associated with the historic region of Courland. Eduard von Keyserling was a poets & playwrights from Kalvene Parish (1855-05-14, Kalvene Parish–1918-09-28). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
